title: AV Treasury Testnet — Full Semantic Map
text: AV Treasury testnet is a self-contained Hardhat localnet (chainId 31337, RPC http://localhost:8545) running interval mining (auto:false, interval:1000ms). It exercises the full flywheel: mock Aerodrome router swaps (AU/AG/USDC/WETH), TreasuryAMO buyback, TreasuryFlashBuy_v2, AVLPStaking_v2 LP stake/unstake, PID_Emission_Controller_V2 emission, OracleWrapper price checks. Deploy via scripts/deploy_testnet.js. Analytics engine at deployments/testnet/analytics/engine.js logs granular per-contract/per-function calls, gas, success/fail to log.jsonl.

title: Testnet Roles & Accounts
text: Acct#0 deployer=0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266 (Safe owner #1, governor admin). Acct#1 keeper=0x70997970C51812dc3A010C7d01b50e0d17dc79C8 (TreasuryAMO + Flywheel keeper, runs buyback + emission). Acct#2 SafeOwner2=0x3C44CdDdB6a900fa2b585dd299e03d12FA4293BC. 7 traders=random funded wallets. PID_Emission_Controller_V2 holds ADMIN_ROLE on AVLPStaking_v2 (setRewardRates). GovernorContractV5 is governor. ArtifactTimelock is 48h timelock.

title: Testnet Flywheel Flow (verified working)
text: Flow: traders swap on MockAerodromeRouter (buy/sell AU & AG) -> price deviates -> keeper triggers TreasuryAMO.executeBuyback (spends AG reserve, buys AU, holds in AMO) and TreasuryFlashBuy_v2.executeBuyback (flash-loan-style buy) -> LPs stake QuasiCrystalLPNFT via AVLPStaking_v2.stake -> PID_Emission_Controller_V2.executeEmission sets auRewardPerBlock=1, agRewardPerBlock=0.0058 (AU/block, AG/block) -> rewards accrue to stakers -> OracleWrapper.getOraclePrice sanity-checked every 10th tick. AMO cap = 5% of reserve (reserveCapBps=500), dynamic per-epoch; engine skips when reserveAmt<=0.

title: Testnet Known Defects (documented, not yet fixed)
text: DEFECT A: TreasuryAMO holds bought AU (no burn) — totalAuBought == AU balance in AMO. Value accrues as treasury hoard, not deflationary sink. Design decision pending. DEFECT B (FIXED 2026-07-11): engine.js line 256 used bare ethers instead of hre.ethers -> crashed PID_Emission logging (ethers is not defined). Fixed to hre.ethers; PID emission now 0% fail. DEFECT C (historical, resolved): MockAerodromeRouter.addLiquidity stored reserves unsorted -> broke swapExactTokensForTokens aIsTa mapping -> ERC20InsufficientBalance on ag>usdc swaps. Fixed by sorting reserves.

title: Testnet Analytics & Monitoring
text: Engine: deployments/testnet/analytics/engine.js (standalone Node, JsonRpcProvider + Wallet signers, interval-mining node). Logs to deployments/testnet/analytics/log.jsonl (fields: t, contract, fn, ok, gas, err). Summary: node deployments/testnet/analytics/summary.js prints per-contract/per-function calls, fails, fail%, avgGas. Node process: Hardhat interval mining on :8545. Engine process: node engine.js (4 worker procs). All functions currently 0% fail except historical pre-fix PID entries.

title: Mainnet Vector Separation Policy
text: MAINNET vectors are OUT OF SCOPE for this testnet prototype. Mainnet = live Base/ETH deployment with real AU/AG liquidity, real oracle (AvOracle/Chainlink), real governor timelock, real funds. Testnet = localhost chainId 31337, mock ERC20 (MockUSDC), MockAerodromeRouter, interval mining, throwaway accounts. .vdb vectors are namespaced: namespace=testnet for prototype, namespace=mainnet reserved. Never mix testnet addresses into mainnet deployments. deployments/testnet/ is gitignored-safe (not ignored, but clearly separated).

title: Vector Namespacing Convention
text: All .vdb documents carry namespace field: 'testnet' for av_treasury localhost prototype, 'mainnet' for production. testnet.map remaps semantic concepts to TESTNET addresses/roles only. If mainnet addresses are added later, they get namespace=mainnet and a separate mainnet.map. Query isolation: semantic search filters by namespace to prevent testnet mock data contaminating mainnet reasoning.
